## Why this name

- Pops the head of the free list at 0x030040AC; when it is empty it calls the no-op debug reporter with 'No sprites left!' and bails
- Links the popped node into the active list at 0x030040A4, ordering it by the key stored at node->unk22, and decrements the live count at 0x030040B4
- The pool list head 0x030040A4 sits directly beside gBtlObjListHead (0x030040A8), the list BtlObjListMoveToHead operates on
